modules.module_title: Set up and calibrate the Triplex laminator and glue application machines

pcs.pc_description: inspect the Triplex laminator and glue application machines to ensure they are clean, functional, and free from defects before starting setup
select and load the correct liner and fluted paper grades according to production specifications
calibrate machine settings such as roller pressure, speed, and temperature based on the type and GSM of the board to be laminated
aligned feed rollers, glue pans, and delivery belts accurately to ensure proper sheet flow and uniform glue application
adjust glue viscosity and roller speed to achieve optimal adhesive spread and bonding strength
perform trial runs and inspect the initial output for defects like misalignment, bubbling, or glue skips, making necessary adjustments
record and document machine settings and calibration parameters for reference and quality control

modules.module_title: Operate the machines efficiently during production run

pcs.pc_description: monitor machine parameters such as speed, pressure, and temperature continuously to ensure consistent production quality
load and feed raw materials (liner and fluted boards) into the machine smoothly without causing jams or misfeeds
detect and respond promptly to any irregularities in the machine operation, such as unusual noises, vibrations, or product defects
adjust machine controls in real-time to correct issues like glue inconsistencies, sheet misalignment, or uneven lamination
maintain uninterrupted workflow by coordinating with upstream and downstream operators to manage material flow and avoid bottlenecks
conduct routine checks on output quality during production, including visual inspection and basic measurement of board properties
document production data, machine settings, and any incidents or adjustments made during the run for process traceability

pcs.pc_description: inspect and clean rollers, glue pans, and feed mechanisms at regular intervals to prevent glue buildup, jamming, or wear and tear

identify common faults such as uneven glue spread, roller misalignment, or temperature fluctuations and take corrective actions without halting the machine unnecessarily

perform preventive checks on electrical connections, safety guards, and sensors to ensure smooth and safe functioning
maintain a daily maintenance log including observations, actions taken, and parts serviced or replaced
use basic hand tools and cleaning agents appropriately during maintenance tasks while ensuring machine safety
